# T-811 candidate context (unpublished)

Proposed Editor/Core/Phaser/PixiJS version: 0.2.0-alpha.1, local review only.
Use matching candidate package archives and the core/render import-map subpath.
The public RC2 remains unchanged. This candidate adds native approved AI tools,
consented viewport vision, mesh-weight assistance and simple external-FFmpeg MP4.
125 actual headless framebuffer comparisons passed fixed thresholds (104 exact)
on one ANGLE/NVIDIA configuration; manual GUI and broad GPU review remain distinct.
No model/FFmpeg is bundled. Do not infer unsupported runtime constraints/blends.
Jade Sentinel is unchanged RC2; the maintainer's unsaved Qwen edits are not included.

- [Readiness](docs/RELEASE_READINESS.md)

## Historical RC2 context follows

# Ankhimate — Windows + PixiJS experimental alpha

> The editor authors projects; the TypeScript core evaluates native exports and
> the PixiJS adapter renders only the documented native v2 WebGL2 subset.

## Start here

- [Licenses](docs/ALPHA-LICENSES.md)

## Rules for integrations
Use real public APIs; do not invent constraint, blend, linked-mesh or audio support.
Core v1 reading does not mean the PixiJS adapter accepts v1. Do not invert export
coordinates, change normalized curves or reinterpret weighted FFD offsets.
Events at t=0 are ignored on startup and every loop. Interrupted crossfades may
jump. Explicitly clean up instances before their asset. Jade Sentinel is the only
official sample. No AI model is bundled or required.
